data.exact_reserve_text: A favourable run off deviation (prior accident year release) of GBP 3.3m (2016: GBP 1.5m favourable deviation) was experienced during the year.
data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate recorded a favourable prior accident year run-off, a release of GBP 3.3m during 2017 (2016: GBP 1.5m release), representing an approximate 18.8% reduction versus opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 17.563m. The report attributes this to favourable claims development on prior years; no specific prior-year catastrophe or large loss events are named.
raw_causal_phrases: A favourable run off deviation (prior accident year release) of GBP 3.3m (2016: GBP 1.5m favourable deviation) was experienced during the year.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development figure (GBP 3.3m release) is taken from Note 5's narrative. The note gives an explicit amount but does not state whether this is gross or net of reinsurance; no gross 'Insurance liabilities' columned prior-year movement figure is provided. Therefore the reported prior year movement uses the stated figure from the narrative (NET/GROSS ambiguity). The claims development triangle includes an '2011 & Prior' aggregate column which was excluded from triangle-based PYD computations per guidance. Opening reserves taken from the Statement of Financial Position (Long term business provision comparative column).
